title: ShareGrantRequest
description: Grant a share on a collection (POST /v1/collections/{id}/shares body). v1 is read-only. grant_option is not exposed (defaults false) and owner cannot be granted here (ownership is transferred, not granted).

grantee.description: Who to share with. The literal '@public'/'public' maps to the built-in public group (read-only); '@group:<id>' (or 'group:<id>') maps to a named group by id; a value containing ':' is a full 'issuer:subject' string kept verbatim; the form '@service:<subject>' names a SERVICE ACCOUNT and keeps its subject colon-free — required for a machine identity, because a bare subject would be qualified to 'bvbrc:<subject>', a federated identity the account can never authenticate as (an inert grant); a bare BV-BRC username is prefixed to 'bvbrc:<username>'. The resolved subject is echoed back in the response so a typo (an unclaimable grant) is visible.

issuer.description: Issuer used to qualify a bare username (default 'bvbrc'). Ignored for '@public', '@group:', '@service:' and for a value that already contains ':'.
